notes.title: Discussion with developer on Discord
notes.content:
Chat with developer
If you have any questions or you would like to discuss about game, join in Discord server.
You can join at any time or if you prefer to wait for scheduled discussion, set a reminder for this event.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37769415/b5f4aaee5028de623bcbd715b73d31b2c2bb0f9e.jpg

Checkout demo

Don't forget to test your smashing skills in demo version of upcoming game Village Fest™: Digging


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37769415/2977ff0bdacd22bbd9e53d9aee85eed97f9ce26d.gif


Info

Village Fest™: Digging is competitive game where goal is to collect as much gold as you can, be it by digging, looting or even stealing.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1302030/Village_Fest_Digging/
